5.6.20 Rte_IWrite Purpose: Provide write access to the VariableDataPrototypes referenced by VariableAccesses in the dataWriteAccess role. Signature: [SWS_Rte_03744] Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_Rte_00129 ⌈ void Rte_[Byps_]IWrite__

_( [IN Rte_Instance ], IN , [IN Std_TransformerForwardCode forwardedCode], [IN uint8* metaDataPtr]) Where is the short name of the RunnableEntity,

the port name and the VariableDataPrototype short name. [Byps_] is an optional infix used when component wrapper method for bypass support is enabled for the related software component type.⌋ Existence: [SWS_Rte_01302] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051 ⌈An Rte_IWrite API shall be created for a provided Variable- DataPrototype if the RunnableEntity has a VariableAccess in the dataWriteAccess role referring to this VariableDataPro- totype.⌋ [SWS_Rte_CONSTR_09084] Rte_IWrite API may only be used by the runnable that describe its usage ⌈The Rte_IWrite API may only be used by the runnable that contains the corresponding VariableAccess in the dataWriteAccess role.⌋ Description: The Rte_IWrite API provides write access to the VariableDat- aPrototypes declared as accessed by a runnable using Vari- ableAccesses in the dataWriteAccess role. The API function is guaranteed to be have constant execution time and therefore can also be used within category 1A runnable entities. No access error information is required for the user – the value can always be written. To provide the required write-back semantics the RTE only makes written values available to other entities after the writing runnable entity has terminated. [SWS_Rte_03746] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00129 ⌈The Rte_IWrite API call includes the IN parameter to pass the data element to write.⌋ The IN parameter is passed by value or reference accord- ing to the ImplementationDataType as described in the section 5.2.6.5.
